statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered for further diagnostic evaluation
The diagnosis code I49.5 (sick sinus syndrome) is associated with this claim
The diagnosis code R42 (dizziness) is associated with this claim
The diagnosis code R55 (syncope) is associated with this claim
The billed balance for this service is 236.71
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
